reason: $147 is nothing to me, that is not the issue. Zero published results and a 3-day trial is not enough time to see whether cold DMs turn into booked calls, and I am not putting my agency's Instagram through an unproven tool when my real problem is the offer and the pipeline, not typing speed.
objection: No proof it books calls, and three days is too short to find out. If the AI openers read like templates or the account gets flagged, I lose a real client-prospecting channel, and after day 4 payments are final.
would_change_my_mind: Real results from agency owners like me (replies and booked calls per 100 DMs, with screenshots), plus a trial long enough (7 to 14 days) to run a real batch and see replies before the card is charged.
